name: The King's Festival
introDiscord:
The throne doors open.

You expect a dark throne room.

Instead—

lanterns ignite.

Hundreds.

Royal banners unfurl from the ceiling.

Old festival mechanisms wake throughout the palace.

Music echoes through halls that have been silent for centuries.

The final chamber is not a tomb.

It is a celebration.

The kingdom's last preserved festival has begun.

the-kings-festival-hall.prompt: The King's Festival opens into three routes through the drowned kingdom.

left.message:
One Berry rests on the grandest table in the entire palace.

A place card beside it reads:

HER ROYAL MAJESTY
SHIZUKI OF HOUSE BERRY

Below it, in smaller handwriting:

'I made the card myself.

Royal appointment remains pending.'

right.message:
The royal festival prize table still holds Star Candies beneath ribbons,
tiny crowns, carved toys, and faded medals from games played centuries
ago.

forward.message:
A Festival Crown Guardian steps beneath the lanterns.

Its armor is polished.

Its crown is crooked.

For some reason, that makes it considerably more charming.

the-kings-festival-court.prompt: Deeper within The King's Festival, three paths wind through the abandoned royal district.

left.message:
A Crown Guardian steps from beneath the royal banners and raises its
ceremonial weapon.

right.message:
A festival fountain still flows beside Shizuki and Glimmer's old camp.

Her note reads:

'WE FOUND THE THRONE.

Celebrated by immediately leaving throne room to try festival games.

Priorities.'
right.fullHpMessage:
You leave the fountain untouched.

You're already ready for the final celebration.

forward.message:
A royal prize coffer opens beneath a festival arch.

Inside are Star Candies and one tiny paper crown.

Shizuki's handwriting:

'Wear it.

Trust me.'

the-kings-festival-throne.prompt: Near The Festival Throne, three final approaches lead onward.

left.message:
An old royal gift chest contains Star Candies and tokens from every
district you crossed:

a garden ribbon.

a tournament medal.

a theater mask.

a tiny animal carving.

a festival bell.

The kingdom fits inside one little box.

right.message:
The final Crown Guardian steps before the throne.

It raises its weapon.

Then performs an elaborate ceremonial bow.

You bow back.

The duel begins.

Royal manners maintained.

forward.message:
Beside the throne rests Shizuki's last restorative bottle in Sunken
King's Throne.

Her final kingdom note reads:

'If you're reading this, you made it.

We explored the markets.

Got lost in the palace.

Went shopping.

Danced badly.

Invaded a kitchen.

Named several animals.

Cheated at festival games.

Glimmer cheated MORE.

And yes—

I found the throne.

Eventually.

Rest up.

The best part is next.'
forward.fullHpMessage:
You leave Shizuki's final restorative beside the throne.

You're already ready.

boss-antechamber.name: The Festival Throne
boss-antechamber.prompt:
The palace bells ring.

Every lantern in Sunken King's Throne ignites at once.

The celebration freezes.

A figure appears before the throne.

Not flesh.

Not a Revenant.

A memory preserved by the palace itself.

A crown settles upon its head.

bossPromptDiscord:
The Festival Throne shines beneath a thousand lanterns.

A royal memory takes shape at its foot.

For one moment, the kingdom around you is no longer ruined.

The markets are full.

The gardens bloom.

The ballroom dances.

The tournament stands cheer.

The theater curtains rise.

Festival Street glows.

And upon the throne sits the king whose kingdom you've spent this entire
journey getting to know.

The memory stands.

Raises a ceremonial weapon.

Then bows.

One final royal challenge.

Use /yes to accept the King's Festival or /no to let the celebration
wait a little longer.

bossRetreatText:
You step back from the Festival Throne.

The royal memory lowers its weapon.

The lanterns remain lit.

The celebration will wait.

boss.revealText:
The palace bells ring again.

Moonlight pours through the broken ceiling.

The royal memory raises its crown as festival banners sweep through the
throne room.

The Memory of the Sunken King reveals itself!

completionText:
The final strike lands.

The Sunken King's memory lowers its weapon.

For one long moment, nothing happens.

Then—

it laughs.

Not mockingly.

Not bitterly.

Joyfully.

The memory returns its weapon to its side and bows.

Every lantern in the kingdom bursts into light.

The palace changes around you.

Not permanently.

Just a memory.

But for a few impossible moments, Sunken King's Throne lives again.

You see Crownmarket Square filled with merchants.

The fountains running.

Royal horses crossing the stables.

Jousting crowds cheering.

Servants carrying ridiculous amounts of food from the kitchens.

Musicians tuning inside the theater.

Children racing through the hedge maze.

Guests crowding the banquet hall.

Festival Street blazing with lanterns.

A kingdom.

Not records.

Not laws.

Not treaties.

People.

Then the memory begins fading.

The market empties.

The banners grow still.

The palace returns to the sea.

But the festival lanterns remain.

One final journal page rests on the throne.

Shizuki's handwriting:

'Best kingdom ever.

Official review:

Markets: ★★★★★
Gardens: ★★★★★
Ballroom: ★★★★★
Kitchen: dangerous but ★★★★★
Jousting: I won so ★★★★★
Festival: ★★★★★★★★★★★

Glimmer says that's too many stars.

Glimmer is wrong.

...

We thought this was the end of the road.

It isn't.

There's something strange past the palace.

The current doesn't feel like the others.

It feels like...

everywhere.

Glimmer already went through.

Obviously.

So I guess we're going too~

HEY! WAIT FOR ME!'

Behind the throne, a passage opens.

Not stone.

Not coral.

Not root.

A doorway filled with stars.

Through it, you can glimpse places that should not exist beside one
another:

Moonlit Reef.

Starfall Trench.

Whispering Kelp Forest.

Leviathan's Wake.

The Sunken Kingdom.

All reflected in the same impossible water.

The route to the Astral Nexus is open.

Sunken King's Throne is complete.
